gnosh mem

  Read the project's mem, without a model. The words after mem go to mem as
  they are: show, find and log read it. What changes mem is done with /mem
  inside a session.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh mem [flags] [show [name...] | find <words> | log [n]]

Flags
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
